## HERA — electron D = 0 Landau fan for the stacking call (`landau-fan-vti`)

> **05:27** · landau-fan-vti: D=0 electron n +3.2 to +2.4e12 (20), B +0.9 to +10 T (102 uniform-1/B rows), sr1 100 uV, 2.1 s/pt, Vsi 0 · **ETA ~08:27** (≈3h)

Runs 6–7 completed without gate leakage or clipping. The +3.2×10¹² electron check (run 6, B_1–B_2) has oscillations and candidate ~7 and ~22–30 T content, but the higher peaks may be harmonics of ~7 T; the hole check (run 7) reaches only −1.2×10¹², where the model's near-CNP hole tones overlap. The fan therefore follows the electron side and tests how the peaks move with density, rather than assigning stacking from one trace. Run 5's region-A calibration fixes the D = 0 gate line; the absolute density scale is still the geometry prior, and region B's ~0.43×10¹² density offset may superpose tones on this one contact pair.

The fixed-D line covers **n = +3.2→+2.4×10¹² cm⁻²**, TG **+0.984→+0.754 V**, BG **+1.166→+0.870 V**, V_Si = 0. The density window excludes the low-|n| electron exception where ABAB can mimic an ABCA singleton, and it excludes the hole side because its available density cannot test the separated-pair regime. Field is **+0.9→+10.0 T**, 102 rows uniform in 1/B; the magnet begins at ~0 T and first ramps bare to +0.9 T (~6.6 min), then traverses 9.1 T while measuring (~66.4 min bare ramp floor). The 20-point gate line is paired, descending in n. At n_max, F_L = 33.1 T and Δ(1/B)=0.01001 T⁻¹ gives 3.02 samples per fastest period; at B_min, Δn=0.0421×10¹² is below half the fourfold LL ray spacing (0.0435×10¹²). The 1/B window is 1.011 T⁻¹ (δF≈0.99 T if signal survives from 0.9 T); run 6's ~7 T track was robust only from ~1.35 T, for which the usable δF worsens to ~1.56 T and the weak partner may have fewer than five periods in low-n columns. A missing partner there will be reported as unresolved, not absent.

Fixed sr1 sensitivity **100 µV** gives ~10 kΩ nominal full scale at 10 nA: run 6's 10 T maximum was 530 Ω at n=3.2; the lower-n/high-B corner controls headroom and gets an automatic 90%-range abort. The fast-axis dwell is **2.1 s** (7τ for the recorded 0.3 s / 24 dB lock-in), and the blocking field driver adds its 3 s settle per row. Price: 2,040 points × ~2.27 s/point from run 5's 1.17 s/point at 1.0 s dwell ≈77 min, plus 73 min field traverse, ~5 min row settles, turnarounds and 10% margin → **~3 h**. Check the first 2–3 rows for leakage, rail, live current and field progression; check near 3, 6 and 8 T for developing density-tracking oscillations. A sustained rail, leak trip, or dead channel stops the fan; after any abort, read actual field and gates before another move. The fan ends at +10 T with gates at n=+2.4 for a possible high-field follow-up; no hidden return traverse is charged to this cell.

# Electron D=0 per-column SdH fan: region-A calibration from gatemap run 5.
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

CAL = dict(c_tg=2.7960593093052633e-3, c_bg=2.160696465377614e-3,
           n_offset=-0.08937933224099137, D_offset=-0.013)
N_LO, N_HI, D0 = 2.4, 3.2, 0.0  # 1e12 cm^-2, V/nm
N_N, N_B, B_START, B_END = 20, 102, 0.9, 10.0
FAST_DELAY, SLOW_DELAY = 2.1, 0.0
SENS, I_TRIP = 100e-6, 1e-9

# Preconditions: these are state the fan assumes but does not set. Print the
# readback before any instrument write; a mismatch raises before the field moves.
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"],
                        max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T, _Tv = T_sample(), T_vaporizer()
_B, _tg, _bg, _si = magnet.field(), k_tg.volt(), k_bg.volt(), k_si()
_ps, _out = magnet.persistent_switch_on(), magnet.output_enabled()
_h1, _h2 = heater.sample_range(), heater.vaporizer_range()
_dc_range, _dc_out = dc205.voltage_range(), dc205.output()
print(f"preconditions: T_sample={_T:.3f} K (1.0..1.5), T_vaporizer={_Tv:.3f} K (0.7..1.5), "
      f"B={_B:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05), TG={_tg:+.4f}, BG={_bg:+.4f}, Si={_si:+.4f} V (all 0); "
      f"PS={_ps}, output={_out} (both True), heater ranges={_h1}/{_h2} (0/0), "
      f"DC205 range/output={_dc_range}/{_dc_out} (2/1)")
assert 1.0 <= _T <= 1.5 and 0.7 <= _Tv <= 1.5
assert abs(_B) < 0.05 and abs(_tg) < 0.01 and abs(_bg) < 0.01 and abs(_si) < 0.01
assert _ps and _out and _h1 == 0 and _h2 == 0 and _dc_range == 2 and _dc_out == 1
assert (TG_MIN, TG_MAX, BG_MIN, BG_MAX, SI_MIN, SI_MAX) == (-0.3, 1.0, -1.3, 2.0, -25.0, 25.0)
assert B_SESSION_CAP == 10.0 and T_SESSION_CAP == 100.0
_tau, _slope = sr1.time_constant(), sr1.filter_slope()
print(f"settling/bias: sr1 tau={_tau} s (0.3), slope={_slope} dB/oct (24), "
      f"drive={sr1.amplitude()} V (1.0), sr0 sens={sr0.sensitivity()} V (0.02)")
assert _tau == 0.3 and _slope == 24 and abs(sr1.amplitude()-1.0) < 0.01
assert abs(sr0.sensitivity()-0.02) < 1e-9

ns = np.linspace(N_HI, N_LO, N_N)
Ds = np.zeros_like(ns)
Vtgs, Vbgs = calc_gate_voltages(ns, Ds, **CAL)
B_vec = 1.0 / np.linspace(1.0/B_START, 1.0/B_END, N_B)
assert np.all((TG_MIN <= Vtgs) & (Vtgs <= TG_MAX))
assert np.all((BG_MIN <= Vbgs) & (Vbgs <= BG_MAX))
assert np.all((0 < B_vec) & (B_vec <= B_SESSION_CAP))
for v in Vtgs: k_tg.volt.vals.validate(float(v))
for v in Vbgs: k_bg.volt.vals.validate(float(v))
for b in B_vec: magnet.field.vals.validate(float(b))
_nr, _dr = calc_nD(Vtgs, Vbgs, **CAL)
assert np.max(abs(_nr - ns)) < 1e-4 and np.max(abs(_dr)) < 1e-4
_inv_step = abs(1/B_vec[1] - 1/B_vec[0])
_FL = 33.0848  # h*n_max/(4e), n_max=3.2e12 cm^-2
_half_ray = 0.0435238  # 0.5*(4e/h)*B_start in 1e12 cm^-2

print(f"grid: {N_B} B rows {B_vec[0]:.3f}->{B_vec[-1]:.3f} T, "
      f"d(1/B)={_inv_step:.5f} 1/T; {N_N} n points {ns[0]:+.2f}->{ns[-1]:+.2f}e12, "

s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)

s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.P)

def fan_guard(station, data):
    itg, ibg = abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6]))
    vx = abs(float(data[9]))
    if itg > I_TRIP or ibg > I_TRIP or vx > 0.9*SENS:
        print(f"FAN TRIP B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T, TG={float(data[2]):+.3f}, BG={float(data[3]):+.3f} V: "
